prior_zero_shot_name: ER protein folding in secretory/erythroid cells
programme_name: IgA dimer assembly and J-chain secretion
functional_description: This programme represents a specialized plasma cell state focused on polymeric immunoglobulin A (pIgA) assembly and secretion. The coordinate upregulation of JCHAIN (J-chain for IgA/IgM polymerization), IGLV3-27 (lambda light chain), and plasma cell markers indicates engagement of the dimeric IgA assembly pathway, where J-chain facilitates inter-Ig disulfide bonding and subsequent transcytosis via pIgR. The prominent appearance of globin genes (HBA1, HBA2, HBB, HBD, HBM) reflects the aberrant erythroid gene expression programme paradoxically active in some bone marrow plasma cells.
key_evidence: JCHAIN: Essential adaptor protein enabling IgA/IgM polymerization; J-chain presence diagnostic of pIgA-secreting plasma cells
IGLV3-27: Lambda light chain usage; indicates committed immunoglobulin secretion state with lambda isotype restriction
AHSP: Hemoglobin assembly chaperone suggesting erythroid differentiation signals or transdifferentiation within plasma cell compartment
CCND1: Cell cycle licensing protein compatible with activated plasma cell proliferation before terminal secretory differentiation
MZB1: ER-resident protein involved in immunoglobulin trafficking and plasma cell homeostasis in bone marrow niche
suggested_validation: Sort feature 148-high B cells by plasma cell vs mature B markers, then perform flow cytometry for IgA+IgG-IgM- co-staining with JCHAIN protein expression; validate by RT-qPCR showing J-chain and IGLV3-27 coordinate upregulation in sorted IgA+ plasma cells versus IgG+ plasma cells.

prior_zero_shot_name: ER protein folding and secretory stress
programme_name: ER chaperone-mediated Ig folding and oxidative stress management
functional_description: This programme activates a coordinated ER protein folding response centred on PDI family disulfide isomerases (PDIA6, P4HB) and the canonical chaperone CALR, coupled with antioxidant defences (PRDX2, GSTP1) to manage the oxidative burden of high-throughput immunoglobulin synthesis. The enrichment in Large Pre-B cells (37.5%) and Plasma Cells (43%) indicates activation during transition to antibody secretion, when ER redox stress and misfolded protein accumulation peak. DAD1 provides apoptotic brake function during this proteotoxic stress window.
key_evidence: PDIA6: PDI family member; catalyses disulfide bond formation/isomerisation—rate-limiting for Ig heavy and light chain folding in ER
P4HB: Prolyl hydroxylase and PDI activity; essential for collagen-like Ig structural stabilisation and ER protein folding capacity
CALR: Canonical ER chaperone binding misfolded glycoproteins; directly partners with PDIA6 in the calnexin cycle for Ig maturation
PRDX2: Peroxiredoxin antioxidant; mitigates ROS generated by ER oxidoreductases during high-rate disulfide bond formation
GSTP1: Glutathione S-transferase; detoxifies reactive aldehydes and lipid peroxides accumulated during ER proteotoxic stress
DAD1: Anti-apoptotic factor preventing CHOP-mediated death during UPR; stabilises ER folding capacity under load
UBB: Ubiquitin; primes misfolded Ig for ERAD when folding fails despite chaperone intervention
suggested_validation: Co-immunoprecipitate PDIA6 and CALR from plasma cells ± proteasome/ERAD inhibitors; measure Ig folding kinetics (pulse-chase with anti-Ig antibodies) and ER redox state (roGFP2) in feature-high vs feature-low plasma cells to confirm chaperone-dependent Ig maturation capacity.

programme_name: IgG isotype-switched plasma cell secretion

key_evidence: IGHG1/IGHG3: Heavy chain components diagnostic of IgG isotype commitment and plasma cell differentiation
SSR4: Delta subunit of translocon complex essential for co-translational translocation of Ig heavy chains into ER lumen
FKBP11: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerase specifically required for folding proline-rich IgG domains with complex 3D structure
SEC11C: Signal peptidase critical for cleavage of N-terminal signal peptide from nascent IgG chains during translocation
MZB1: ER-resident protein implicated in plasma cell differentiation and Ig secretion capacity
PRDX4: ER-localised peroxiredoxin protecting Ig disulfide bond formation from oxidative damage during high-volume secretion
suggested_validation: FACS sort CD27+ CD38+ IgG+ plasma cells and perform selective blocking of FKBP11 or SSR4 (siRNA or inhibitor) with measurement of IgG secretion rate and ER stress markers (XBP1s, BiP) to confirm proline isomerisation and translocon function are rate-limiting in this IgG-producing population.

prior_zero_shot_name: ER stress and secretory protein processing
programme_name: IgKappa light chain-coupled ER translocon and chaperone folding
functional_description: This programme coordinates immunoglobulin kappa light chain (IGKC) secretion with active ER translocon machinery (SSR4, SEC11C) and prolyl-isomerase-mediated protein folding (FKBP11, FKBP2). SSR4: Translocon-associated protein (TRAP) delta subunit—essential for co-translational translocation; presence indicates active ribosome-ER coupling for nascent Ig chain synthesis
SEC11C: Signal peptidase catalytic subunit—required for signal peptide cleavage of secreted proteins; directly couples translocation to Ig chain processing

FKBP11 + FKBP2: Prolyl-isomerases catalysing cis/trans isomerization—essential for proper folding of proline-rich Ig domains; dual presence indicates high folding demand
PRDX4 + SELENOM: ER-resident redox enzymes—maintain oxidizing environment for disulfide bond formation in Ig constant domains and prevent oxidative damage during secretion
suggested_validation: Perform dual immunofluorescence for IGKC + SSR4/SEC11C in sorted CD138+ plasma cells, followed by quantitative proteomics of IGKC-interacting partners (FKBP11, SDF2L1, MZB1) to confirm stoichiometric coupling of light chain synthesis to translocon and folding machinery; compare to IgLambda+ plasma cells to confirm kappa-specificity.

programme_name: IgM secretory pathway and ER protein translocation

SEC11C: signal peptidase activity; essential for N-terminal cleavage of Ig heavy chain signal peptides during ER entry

FKBP11: peptidyl-prolyl isomerase; catalyses cis/trans proline isomerisation critical for Ig constant region folding kinetics
DERL3: derlin family ER membrane protein; involved in retro-translocation of misfolded heavy chains during ER-associated degradation
S100A6: EF-hand calcium-binding protein; calcium signalling during ER stress and Ig folding surveillance

SSR4: Translocon-associated protein delta subunit; core ER translocation machinery for light chain entry
DERL3: Derlin family member in ER; mediates ERAD of misfolded immunoglobulin
MANF: ER/secretory pathway protein; UPR-induced stress response factor

SSR4: Translocon-associated protein required for co-translational translocation of Ig into ER lumen
PRDX4: ER-localised antioxidant maintaining optimal disulfide bond formation environment
suggested_validation: Perform XBP1 chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP-seq) on bone marrow plasma cells to confirm direct XBP1s-binding at promoters of PDIA6, P4HB, HSP90B1, SDF2L1, and MANF; validate that knockout or dominant-negative XBP1 splicing impairs feature activation and reduces Ig secretion capacity measured by ELISA.

prior_zero_shot_name: ER protein folding and secretory load
programme_name: IgA heavy chain secretory pathway and ER quality control

SSR4: Translocon-associated protein delta subunit required for co-translational translocation of IgA1 across ER membrane
HSP90B1: ER-resident chaperone essential for conformational maturation of Ig heavy chains before export
DERL3: ERAD-resident derlin specifically recognizing misfolded Ig heavy chain intermediates for proteasomal clearance
HERPUD1: Direct UPR-target and ERAD-associated ubiquitin ligase adaptor activated by Ig secretory load
FKBP11: Prolyl isomerase catalyzing proline-dependent domain refolding critical for Ig disulfide bond formation
MANF: ER-resident stress response factor providing survival signal during high-capacity secretion phase

prior_zero_shot_name: Mitochondrial OXPHOS and ER protein processing
programme_name: IgG2-IgLambda secretion with ER quality control
functional_description: This programme represents differentiated B cells transitioning to plasma cells, characterised by IgG2 and lambda light chain (IGLC2) expression coupled with active endoplasmic reticulum quality control. key_evidence: IGHG2: IgG2 heavy chain; diagnostic of IgG-switched plasma cell commitment

SSR4: Translocon-associated protein complex delta subunit; essential for co-translational translocation of nascent heavy/light chains into ER lumen

CD27: TNF receptor superfamily member; activation marker of memory B cells and early plasma cell differentiation
TNFRSF13B (BAFF-R): Survival signal from bone marrow niche; sustains plasma cell viability
suggested_validation: Isolate IgG2+ lambda+ B cells from bone marrow and perform pulse-chase metabolic labelling with 35S-methionine/cysteine, measuring ER-to-Golgi transit kinetics of newly synthesised IGHG2+IGLC2 dimers in presence/absence of DERL3 knockdown; confirm ERLEC1-dependent recognition of misfolded intermediates by immunoprecipitating ERLEC1 with misfolded IgG2 oligomers under reducing conditions.

programme_name: IgLambda light chain ER-resident chaperone maturation
functional_description: This programme activates IgLambda light chain secretion (IGLC2) coupled with endoplasmic reticulum chaperone-mediated protein folding and disulfide bond formation. The coordinated upregulation of signal peptidase (SEC11C), peptidyl-prolyl isomerases (FKBP11, FKBP2), protein disulfide isomerases (PDIA6, P4HB), and the translocon complex (SSR4) orchestrates co-translational translocation and oxidative folding of lambda light chains. key_evidence: IGLC2: lambda light chain constant region—diagnostic marker of lambda-restricted plasma cells; its prevalence (rank 1) confirms this is not kappa/IgG-dominant
SEC11C: signal peptidase catalyzes co-translational signal peptide cleavage for nascent chain entry into ER lumen—essential first step of secretory pathway

FKBP11, FKBP2, PDIA6, P4HB: collectively encode peptidyl-prolyl isomerases and protein disulfide isomerases; these chaperones catalyze proline-containing loop formation and disulfide bond rearrangement critical for immunoglobulin folding
SSR4: delta subunit of Sec61 translocon complex; required for active translocation of nascent Ig chains across ER membrane
XBP1: master transcription factor of UPR; upregulation indicates ER stress-sensing and activation of chaperone gene expression programme
PRDX4: ER-localized antioxidant peroxiredoxin; maintains oxidative environment necessary for disulfide bond formation without ER stress
suggested_validation: Perform single-cell RNA-seq + protein staining on purified plasma cells using anti-lambda light chain and anti-XBP1(s) spliced form antibodies; sort XBP1(s)+ lambda+ cells and validate that FKBP11, PDIA6, P4HB transcript abundance correlates with successfully secreted lambda-Ig protein levels via LC-MS/MS quantitation of lambda:kappa light chain ratio in supernatant.

XBP1 activation indicates coordinated transcriptional upregulation of the unfolded protein response (UPR) to support increased secretory load.
key_evidence: IGKC: Defines kappa light chain isotype restriction; top-ranked diagnostic marker of this specific Ig subtype
PDIA6, P4HB: ER-resident protein disulfide isomerases essential for Ig heavy-light chain disulfide bond formation and folding
FKBP11, FKBP2: Peptidyl-prolyl cis/trans isomerases that catalyse backbone rotations required for efficient Ig domain folding
SEC11C, SSR4: Signal peptidase and translocon components enabling co-translational translocation and signal sequence removal
XBP1: Master regulator of ER chaperone transcriptional programme; indicates active UPR initiation without ER stress-mediated apoptosis

programme_name: IgLambda light chain secretion with ER-associated quality control

key_evidence: IGLC3: Diagnostic lambda light chain isotype—directly specifies lambda-restricted plasma cell identity
SEC11C: Signal peptidase C catalyzes N-terminal cleavage of nascent Ig chains during translocon translocation—essential first step of secretory pathway entry
FKBP11: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerase essential for proline-rich Ig domain folding; plasma cells show exquisite FKBP dependence due to high Ig synthesis rates

programme_name: IgKappa light chain secretory pathway and ER protein folding

MZB1: ER-resident chaperone supporting nascent chain handling during secretory pathway transit

programme_name: ER chaperone-mediated Ig light chain folding

key_evidence: PDIA6: Rate-limiting ER disulfide isomerase essential for Ig light chain (and heavy chain) disulfide bond maturation
IGKC: Direct diagnostic marker of kappa light chain synthesis; presence confirms this is Ig secretion-specific, not generic ER stress
XBP1: Unspliced XBP1 ATF6-like activity upregulates ER chaperone transcription; marks active adaptive UPR for Ig folding capacity
P4HB: Prolyl hydroxylase with dual isomerase and oxidoreductase activity; forms inter-chain disulfides in Ig dimers
FKBP11 + FKBP2: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases that accelerate trans-proline peptide bond rotation; rate-limiting for Ig folding kinetics
SSR4: Translocon-associated protein complex subunit; maintains open translocon channel during active light chain translocation
DAD1: OST complex component; catalyzes N-glycosylation co-translationally; quality control marker for properly-folded Ig

programme_name: IgKappa light chain secretion with ER chaperone folding

FKBP11: peptidyl-prolyl isomerase catalysing cis-trans isomerization of proline residues critical for Ig domain folding kinetics
SEC11C, SSR4: signal peptide processing and translocon components required for co-translational translocation of secretory Ig into ER lumen
PRDX4: ER-localised antioxidant managing ROS generated during oxidative disulfide bond formation in the ER

programme_name: IgKappa light chain secretory pathway maturation

P4HB: Prolyl hydroxylase and PDI family member enabling proper folding of Ig domains requiring hydroxylated prolines
SEC11C: Signal peptidase processing kappa chain signal peptides during nascent chain translocation
PRDX4: ER-resident antioxidant managing ROS during oxidative disulfide bond formation in Ig assembly

programme_name: XBP1-driven ER chaperone-mediated Ig folding

PDIA6: ER protein disulfide isomerase catalysing essential disulfide bond formation in Ig heavy/light chains
P4HB: Prolyl 4-hydroxylase (PDI family) enabling proline-dependent Ig folding; rate-limiting for secretory pathway capacity
FKBP11, FKBP2: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases accelerating post-translational Ig folding kinetics in ER lumen
SSR4, SEC11C: Translocon and signal peptidase components required for co-translational translocation of nascent Ig chains

programme_name: IgKappa secretion with ER-UPR chaperone activation

programme_name: IgLambda light chain secretion with ER chaperone folding

XBP1: Master transcriptional regulator of UPR initiation and ER chaperone transcription in antibody-secreting cells
FKBP11 and FKBP2: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases essential for correct folding of proline-rich immunoglobulin constant and variable domains

programme_name: IgLambda light chain secretory pathway priming

programme_name: IgKappa light chain secretion with ER chaperone support
functional_description: This programme coordinates IgKappa immunoglobulin light chain synthesis with active endoplasmic reticulum (ER) protein folding and quality control. The feature is driven by IGKC expression combined with a dedicated cohort of ER chaperones (PDIA6, P4HB, FKBP11, FKBP2) and signal peptide processing enzymes (SEC11C, SSR4), indicating active translocon-mediated protein translocation and prolyl isomerase-catalysed disulfide bond maturation specific to the secretory pathway demands of antibody production.
key_evidence: IGKC: Kappa light chain constant region—diagnostic marker of IgKappa-secreting plasma cells; t-test specifically enriched in activating cells
PDIA6, P4HB: PDI family members catalysing disulfide bond formation in nascent Ig heavy and light chains within ER lumen
FKBP11, FKBP2: Prolyl cis/trans isomerases essential for efficient folding of proline-rich Ig domains during synthesis
SEC11C, SSR4: Signal peptidase and translocon-associated protein components required for co-translational translocation of secreted Ig into ER
XBP1: Master UPR transcription factor; presence confirms active ER stress response signature in high-rate antibody-secreting cells
CD63, MZB1: Secretory pathway trafficking factors; CD63 marks secretory vesicles, MZB1 is a plasma cell-restricted protein involved in Ig assembly
suggested_validation: Perform flow cytometry on BoneMarrowMap plasma cells with intracellular staining for IgKappa + IgLambda to confirm this feature is IgKappa-restricted (not IgLambda); co-stain with ER-Tracker or use phospho-eIF2α (indicator of active UPR) to validate ER stress signature; isolate feature-high cells and perform quantitative proteomics on ER-lumen proteins (PDIA6, P4HB) vs feature-low plasma cells to measure relative ER chaperone abundance.

programme_name: IgKappa secretory pathway: signal peptide processing and ER chaperone-mediated folding
functional_description: This programme coordinates IgKappa light chain synthesis with signal peptide cleavage (SSR4, SEC11C) and ER chaperone-mediated disulfide bond formation (P4HB, PDIA6, FKBP11, FKBP2). The coordinated expression of XBP1 (IRE1α effector transcription factor) with prolyl isomerases and protein disulfide isomerases indicates active UPR signalling coupled to productive secretory pathway expansion, distinct from misfolded protein clearance. PRDX4 provides redox homoeostasis for the oxidative ER environment required for Ig folding.
key_evidence: IGKC: Directly encodes IgKappa constant region; definitively identifies IgKappa-secreting plasma cells
SSR4: Translocon delta subunit; diagnostic of active cotranslational translocation of signal-peptide-bearing nascent Ig chains
SEC11C: Signal peptidase; catalyses signal peptide cleavage of mature Ig proteins post-translocation
XBP1: IRE1α-activated transcription factor; indicates UPR activation in response to high-volume Ig synthesis
P4HB + PDIA6: Protein disulfide isomerase isoforms; catalyse inter- and intrachain disulfide bond formation critical for Ig stability
FKBP11 + FKBP2: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases; facilitate proper folding of proline-rich constant regions
PRDX4: ER-localised peroxiredoxin; maintains redox environment for disulfide bond formation
suggested_validation: Perform surface immunoglobulin staining (flow cytometry) combined with intracellular IgKappa quantification on cells sorted for high Feature 24 activity, followed by ER stress reporter assays (XBP1-splicing qPCR or CHOP-GFP) to confirm coordinated UPR activation with IgKappa secretion; contrast with IgLambda+ or IgG+ plasma cells to establish light-chain specificity.

programme_name: IgKappa light chain secretion with ER-folding quality control
functional_description: This programme coordinates IgKappa light chain production (IGKC) with endoplasmic reticulum (ER) translocon machinery (SSR4, SEC11C) and ER-resident protein disulfide isomerases (PDIA6, P4HB, FKBP11, FKBP2) that catalyse cysteine bond formation in immunoglobulin domains. XBP1 co-activation indicates integrated unfolded protein response (UPR) signalling to maintain proteostasis during high-rate secretion, supported by antioxidant (PRDX4) and ER-associated quality control components (DAD1, MZB1).
key_evidence: IGKC: Kappa light chain constant region—diagnostic marker of IgKappa-secreting plasma cells
SSR4: Signal sequence receptor delta subunit—core translocon component for co-translational translocation of secretory proteins into ER lumen
PDIA6, P4HB: ER-resident protein disulfide isomerases—catalyse disulphide bond formation essential for Ig domain stability
XBP1: ER stress-responsive transcription factor—master regulator of UPR and ER chaperone/ERAD genes during secretory burden
SEC11C: Signal peptidase—processes signal peptides from nascent secretory proteins including Ig chains
FKBP11, FKBP2: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases—accelerate proline-rich region folding in Ig constant domains
suggested_validation: Perform surface/intracellular IgKappa staining by flow cytometry on feature-positive vs -negative plasma cells, combined with XBP1s splicing qPCR to confirm XBP1-driven UPR activation is specifically coordinated with kappa light chain secretion

programme_name: IgKappa secretory pathway ER chaperone network
functional_description: This programme represents coordinated activation of immunoglobulin kappa light chain (IGKC) secretion coupled with endoplasmic reticulum (ER) chaperone machinery for protein folding and quality control. The signature includes IGKC paired with classical ER chaperones (PDIA6, P4HB, FKBP11), signal peptidase activity (SEC11C), translocon machinery (SSR4), and ER-resident lectin-mediated ERAD surveillance (ERLEC1), indicating active synthesis and ER-dependent secretory pathway engagement without overt unfolded protein response stress.
key_evidence: IGKC: Diagnostic kappa light chain constant region—defines IgKappa-producing plasma cell subset
PDIA6: Protein disulfide isomerase essential for Ig heavy-light chain disulfide bonding
P4HB: ER-resident PDI catalysing proline hydroxylation in collagen-like Ig C-region folding
SEC11C: Signal peptidase catalysing N-terminal signal peptide removal post-translational translocation
SSR4: Translocon-associated protein complex directing nascent Ig chain into ER lumen
FKBP11: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerase accelerating folding of kappa light chain framework regions
ERLEC1: ER-resident lectin recognising N-glycans on misfolded intermediates for selective ERAD
XBP1: Spliced form (XBP1s) inducing ER chaperone and ERAD component expression during secretory load
suggested_validation: Perform co-immunoprecipitation of IGKC with PDIA6, P4HB and SSR4 in sorted IgKappa+ plasma cells, followed by quantitative mass spectrometry to confirm transient Ig-chaperone complex formation during active secretion, and validate XBP1 splicing status by qRT-PCR to confirm UPR pathway activation state.

programme_name: IgKappa light chain secretion with ER chaperone folding
functional_description: This programme coordinates IgKappa immunoglobulin light chain synthesis with active endoplasmic reticulum protein folding and quality control. The co-activation of IGKC (kappa light chain), SEC11C (signal peptidase), and a comprehensive ER chaperone network (FKBP11, PDIA6, P4HB, XBP1) indicates coordinated translocation, disulfide bond formation, and protein maturation in the secretory pathway. XBP1 activation suggests UPR engagement to expand ER capacity for high-volume Ig secretion.
key_evidence: IGKC: diagnostic kappa light chain constant region—defines isotype specificity
SEC11C: signal peptidase essential for co-translational N-terminal cleavage of secretory Ig precursors
XBP1: master UPR transcription factor—activates ER chaperone expansion and secretory capacity
FKBP11: prolyl isomerase—catalyzes cis/trans proline isomerization critical for Ig disulfide-rich domain folding
PDIA6: protein disulfide isomerase—mediates inter-chain and intra-chain disulfide bond formation in light and heavy chains
P4HB: prolyl 4-hydroxylase—stabilizes collagen-like regions; also has PDI activity for disulfide bond management
PRDX4: ER-resident antioxidant—protects nascent Ig from oxidative damage during folding
DAD1: component of translocon; prevents ER stress-induced apoptosis during high secretory demand
suggested_validation: Co-immunofluorescence of IGKC + XBP1(spliced) + PDIA6 in sorted CD138+ plasma cells, with FACS validation that IGKC+ cells show elevated IRE1α activation (XBP1 splicing); optionally measure kappa:lambda ratio and compare ER chaperone abundance between IgKappa vs IgLambda plasma cells.

programme_name: IgG heavy chain secretion with ER stress response
functional_description: This programme coordinates IgG3/IgG1 heavy chain synthesis with ER chaperone-mediated folding and UPR activation. The transcription factor XBP1 and ER stress sensors (HERPUD1) drive expansion of the secretory pathway, while FKBP11 and PRDX4 provide prolyl isomerase and antioxidant activity to stabilize nascent Ig in the oxidising ER environment. SSR4 and SEC11C components of the translocon ensure efficient signal peptide-dependent translocation of immunoglobulin into the ER lumen.
key_evidence: IGHG3/IGHG1: IgG heavy chain isotypes—diagnostic of IgG-secreting plasma cells rather than IgM or IgA
XBP1: Master regulator of UPR and ER chaperone transcription; hallmark of active secretory programme
FKBP11: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerase essential for folding proline-rich Ig constant domains and Fc regions
SSR4/SEC11C: Translocon and signal peptidase components; signal peptide processing is rate-limiting for ER entry
HERPUD1: ERAD ubiquitin ligase activated by ER stress; indicates active quality control of misfolded Ig
PRDX4: ER-localised peroxiredoxin; scavenges ROS generated during Ig disulphide bond formation
MZB1: Plasma cell-specific ER-resident protein; supports sustained secretory capacity
suggested_validation: Co-culture IgG+ plasma cells with XBP1 inhibitor or PERK inhibitor and measure IGHG3/IGHG1 transcription and intracellular Ig accumulation by flow cytometry to confirm XBP1-driven secretory programme dependency.

programme_name: IgLambda light chain secretion with ER-ERAD quality control
functional_description: This programme coordinates IgLambda (IGLC3) light chain production with active endoplasmic reticulum protein folding, quality control, and ER-associated degradation (ERAD) mechanisms. The feature integrates translocon-mediated protein translocation (SSR4, SEC11C), prolyl isomerase-catalysed Ig folding (FKBP11, FKBP2, CRELD2), misfolded protein recognition and refolding (SDF2L1, MZB1), ERAD initiation via derlin-mediated retrotranslocation (DERL3, ERLEC1), and XBP1-driven UPR transcriptional response to sustain ER protein processing capacity.
key_evidence: IGLC3: Diagnostic IgLambda light chain constant region—defines lambda-restricted plasma cells
XBP1: Master UPR transcription factor activated by ER stress during high-rate Ig secretion
SSR4: Signal Recognition Particle receptor delta subunit essential for co-translational translocation of Ig into ER lumen
SEC11C: Signal peptidase catalysing removal of hydrophobic leader sequences from nascent light chains
FKBP11, FKBP2: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases that resolve proline cis/trans peptide bonds in Ig constant domains
SDF2L1: ER chaperone cofactor binding misfolded proteins and mediating HSP90/GRP94-dependent refolding
DERL3, ERLEC1: ERAD initiation factors; ERLEC1 recognises N-glycan exposure on terminally misfolded Ig; DERL3 recruits AAA-ATPases for retrotranslocation
CRELD2: Calcium-binding protein with protein disulfide isomerase activity—stabilises disulphide bonds in light chain domains
PRDX4: ER-resident antioxidant preventing disulphide bond scrambling during Ig folding
suggested_validation: Perform lentiviral knockdown of IGLC3, XBP1, or DERL3 in cultured plasma cells, measure: (1) surface/secreted IgLambda levels by flow cytometry and ELISA; (2) accumulation of ubiquitinated Ig aggregates by immunoblot; (3) apoptosis rates via annexin V staining to confirm ERAD activation protects viability during light chain synthesis stress.

programme_name: IgG2 secretory pathway with XBP1-driven ER chaperone folding
functional_description: This programme represents active IgG2 plasma cells engaged in heavy-chain synthesis and secretion, characterized by coordinated upregulation of XBP1-mediated ER stress response and prolyl isomerase-assisted Ig folding. The translocon machinery (SSR4, SEC11C), peptidyl-prolyl isomerases (FKBP11, FKBP2), and the ERAD-associated HERPUD1 work in concert to manage the high flux of misfolded immunoglobulin through quality control checkpoints, while S100A6 and PRDX4 provide redox homeostasis for disulfide bond formation in the secretory pathway.
key_evidence: IGHG2: IgG2 heavy chain—diagnostic marker of IgG2-secreting plasma cell subset actively synthesizing this isotype
XBP1: Master transcription factor for plasma cell differentiation and unfolded protein response—activates ER chaperones and ERAD machinery
SSR4: Translocon delta subunit required for signal peptide recognition and co-translational translocation of nascent Ig heavy chains
FKBP11 & FKBP2: Prolyl isomerases essential for efficient folding of proline-rich Ig domains and preventing aggregation during secretory pathway transit
HERPUD1: ERAD ubiquitin ligase adaptor—diagnostic of active ER stress response for clearance of misfolded Ig in quality-control-proficient plasma cells
SEC11C: Signal peptidase complex component—required for cleavage of Ig signal peptide during translocation
suggested_validation: Perform XBP1s splicing qRT-PCR and phospho-eIF2α western blot on FACS-sorted IGHG2+ cells vs other B-cell subsets to confirm active UPR; combine with proteasome inhibitor treatment to assess HERPUD1-mediated ERAD flux capacity

programme_name: IgA heavy chain secretory pathway maturation
functional_description: This programme represents the ER-resident chaperone and translocon machinery required for IgA1 heavy chain synthesis and trafficking. The coordinated expression of SSR4 (translocon component), SEC11C (signal peptidase), FKBP11/FKBP2 (prolyl isomerases), and CRELD2 (PDI-like oxidoreductase) indicates active post-translational folding of immunoglobulin polypeptides within the ER lumen. Co-expression of MANF and MZB1 suggests ER-resident chaperone function and antibody quality control mechanisms.
key_evidence: IGHA1: Diagnostic marker of IgA-secreting plasma cells; IgA is a structurally complex immunoglobulin requiring extensive ER folding
SSR4: Translocon delta subunit essential for co-translational translocation of IgA heavy chains into the ER lumen
FKBP11/FKBP2: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases that facilitate folding of IgA heavy chains containing multiple proline residues in constant regions
SEC11C: Signal peptidase C required for cleavage of signal peptides from nascent IgA chains; critical for productive translocation
CRELD2: ER-resident PDI-like oxidoreductase supporting disulfide bond formation in IgA heavy chains
MZB1: Plasma cell-specific chaperone involved in antibody assembly and quality control within ER compartments
suggested_validation: Perform subcellular fractionation of feature-470-high plasma cells followed by quantitative MS/MS to confirm that SSR4, SEC11C, and CRELD2 are enriched in ER-derived microsomes; validate IgA-specific assembly using co-immunoprecipitation of IGHA1 with FKBP11 and MZB1.

programme_name: IgLambda light chain secretion and ER proteostasis
functional_description: This programme coordinates IgLambda (IGLC3) light chain synthesis with active endoplasmic reticulum (ER) proteostasis mechanisms. It couples signal peptide processing (SEC11C, SSR4) and prolyl isomerase-mediated folding (FKBP11, FKBP2, CRELD2) with ERAD initiation (HERPUD1) and XBP1-driven UPR transcriptional responses to handle the high secretory burden of immunoglobulin production. Lipid metabolism enzymes (PLPP5) and oxidative stress management (PRDX4) support the energetic demands of sustained light chain synthesis.
key_evidence: IGLC3: Directly encodes the lambda light chain constant region—diagnostic of lambda-restricted plasma cells activating this feature
XBP1: Master UPR transcription factor essential for ER chaperone induction and ERAD gene expression in antibody-secreting cells
SEC11C: Signal peptidase essential for removal of hydrophobic signal peptides from nascent lambda light chains during translocation
FKBP11, FKBP2, CRELD2: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases and protein disulfide isomerases catalysing proline-rich immunoglobulin domain folding
HERPUD1: ERAD-associated E3 ubiquitin ligase activated by ER stress to degrade misfolded light chains
SSR4: Core translocon component required for co-translational translocation of lambda light chains into ER lumen
PRDX4: ER-resident antioxidant protecting disulfide bond formation during light chain maturation from oxidative damage
suggested_validation: Sort live plasma cells by surface IgLambda vs IgKappa (flow cytometry), isolate IgLambda+ cells, perform RNA-seq ± XBP1 inhibitor (STF-083) to confirm XBP1-dependent co-activation of IGLC3, FKBP11, HERPUD1, and SEC11C in lambda-secreting cells versus kappa-secreting cells.

programme_name: IgG heavy chain synthesis and ER-driven secretion
functional_description: This programme coordinates IgG isotype-switched plasma cell differentiation with active heavy chain translation and ER translocation machinery. The feature integrates signal peptide processing (SEC11C), translocon assembly (SSR4), prolyl-isomerase chaperone activity (FKBP11), and XBP1-mediated transcriptional control of secretory capacity, coupled with IgG1/3/4 heavy chain expression and oxidative stress management in the ER lumen (PRDX4).
key_evidence: IGKC, IGHG1, IGHG3, IGHG4: Diagnostic IgG-switched immunoglobulin heavy and light chains identifying committed plasma cells at translation stage
SSR4, SEC11C: Core translocon and signal peptidase machinery for co-translational translocation of nascent Ig polypeptides into ER lumen
FKBP11: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerase essential for rapid folding of proline-rich Ig constant regions during synthesis
XBP1: IRE1-activated spliced transcription factor driving plasma cell-specific secretory programme expansion and ER chaperone induction
HERPUD1, PRDX4: ER-resident quality control and redox homeostasis mediating disulfide bond formation and proteotoxic stress management during high-rate Ig synthesis
suggested_validation: Perform XBP1-splicing RT-qPCR on FACS-sorted plasma cells expressing this feature, combined with ATF6/ATF4 ChIP-seq validation of XBP1-target genes (BiP, PDI) to confirm UPR initiation tier within IgG-secreting cells; then co-immunoprecipitate FKBP11 with nascent IgG chains via pulse-chase metabolic labelling.

programme_name: ER chaperone-assisted immunoglobulin folding and quality control
functional_description: This programme coordinates the endoplasmic reticulum proteostasis machinery specifically required for heavy chain (IgA1) folding and secretion in plasma cells. It combines signal peptide processing (SEC11C), prolyl isomerase-mediated proline-rich domain folding (FKBP11, FKBP2), translocon translocation (SSR4), and ER-resident chaperone function (HSP90B1), coupled with ERAD-initiation (ERLEC1 N-glycan recognition) and anti-apoptotic protection during the secretory burden (DAD1). The inclusion of redox enzymes (PRDX4) and vesicular trafficking components (CD63, MZB1) indicates active management of oxidative stress and ER-to-Golgi trafficking during high-volume Ig secretion.
key_evidence: IGHA1: Diagnostic IgA heavy chain constant region; confirms IgA-secreting plasma cell subtype
SEC11C + SSR4: Signal peptidase and translocon core components; required for co-translational translocation of secreted Ig into ER lumen
FKBP11 + FKBP2: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases essential for folding Ig variable and constant domains containing multiple proline residues
HSP90B1: ER-resident ATP-dependent chaperone required for stabilisation of partially folded heavy chains before disulphide bonding
ERLEC1: ER lectinase for N-glycan trimming; initiates ERAD of misfolded Ig molecules
DAD1: Apoptosis antagonist; protects plasma cells from ER stress-induced death during intense secretion
PRDX4: ER-localised peroxiredoxin; maintains reducing environment for disulphide bond formation in Ig
MZB1: ER/extracellular protein; regulates Ig oligomerisation and secretion efficiency
suggested_validation: Perform selective heavy chain folding assay (pulse-chase with emetine block of translation) on FAC-sorted IgA+ plasma cells ± FKBP11/SEC11C knockdown, measuring kinetics of heavy chain homodimerisation and ERAD-dependent degradation by immunoprecipitation; confirm ER localisation and functional interaction of FKBP11+HSP90B1 complex using proximity ligation assay (PLA) in IgA+ cells

programme_name: XBP1-driven ER chaperone and ERAD programme
functional_description: This programme coordinates the unfolded protein response (UPR) and endoplasmic reticulum-associated protein degradation (ERAD) specifically activated in plasma cells secreting kappa light chains. XBP1 transcription factor drives expression of ER translocon machinery (SSR4, SEC11C), prolyl isomerases for Ig folding (FKBP11, FKBP2), and the ubiquitin-proteasome degradation pathway (UBE2J1) to manage proteostasis during high-rate immunoglobulin synthesis. This represents the quality control arm of the secretory response rather than bulk translation or isotype switching.
key_evidence: XBP1: Master transcription factor of the IRE1α-XBP1 UPR pathway; diagnostic of ER stress response activation in plasma cells
FKBP11 + FKBP2: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases essential for efficient disulfide bond formation and proline-containing Ig domain folding
SSR4 + SEC11C: Core translocon and signal peptidase components mediating Ig translocation and N-terminal processing
UBE2J1: E2 ubiquitin conjugase for ERAD; targets misfolded Ig for proteasomal clearance
IGKC: Kappa light chain; specifies kappa isotype plasma cells (not lambda or heavy chain)
JCHAIN: Joined chain protein; indicates commitment to secreted immunoglobulin polymer formation (IgA/IgM)
MZB1: ER-resident chaperone with oxidoreductase activity; assists in disulfide bond shuffling of Ig heavy chains
suggested_validation: Perform ATAC-seq or ChIP-seq on XBP1 in kappa+ vs lambda+ plasma cells to confirm XBP1 binding to promoters of SSR4, FKBP11, UBE2J1; optionally measure ER luminal unfolded protein accumulation (BiP/GRP78 levels) and proteasomal degradation flux in XBP1-knockout vs wildtype plasma cell differentiation using pulse-chase immunoprecipitation of Ig.

programme_name: IgG-lambda secretory pathway with ER-associated protein quality control
functional_description: This programme coordinates IgG heavy chain (IGHG1/IGHG3) and lambda light chain (IGLC2) secretion in plasma cells through coupled translocon-mediated translocation (SSR4, SEC11C) and ER protein quality control. XBP1-driven transcriptional activation of ER chaperones (FKBP11, FKBP2) and ERAD machinery (HERPUD1, DERL3) maintains proteostasis during high-rate immunoglobulin production, with oxidative stress mitigation (PRDX4) supporting sustained secretory capacity.
key_evidence: IGHG1/IGHG3: IgG heavy chain isotypes specifically co-upregulated, indicating committed IgG secretion programme rather than generic plasma cell state
IGLC2: Lambda light chain (not kappa), distinguishing this as IgG-lambda-restricted subtype
SSR4/SEC11C: Translocon and signal peptidase components essential for co-translational translocation of secreted immunoglobulins into ER lumen
XBP1: Master ER stress transcription factor, diagnostic of active UPR initiation driving chaperone and ERAD gene expression
FKBP11/FKBP2: Prolyl isomerases catalysing cis-trans proline isomerization critical for proper Ig heavy/light chain disulfide bond formation
HERPUD1/DERL3: ERAD ubiquitin ligase components removing misfolded Ig aggregates, indicating quality control rather than unfolded protein accumulation
PRDX4: ER-localised antioxidant preventing oxidative protein damage during high-rate disulfide bond formation in Ig assembly
suggested_validation: Co-immunofluorescence of IgG+/lambda+ plasma cells with XBP1-spliced form and HERPUD1/DERL3 localisation to assess coupling of Ig synthesis, ER stress signalling, and ERAD activity; validate with surface IgG/lambda flow cytometry on sorted feature-high cells.

programme_name: IgLambda secretion with ER-associated protein quality control
functional_description: This programme coordinates IgLambda light chain synthesis with active endoplasmic reticulum (ER) protein quality control mechanisms. The feature integrates translocon-mediated protein translocation (SSR4, SEC11C), prolyl isomerase-catalysed Ig folding (FKBP11, FKBP2), ER-resident chaperone cofactors (SDF2L1), and ERAD machinery (ERLEC1, DERL3) to manage misfolded immunoglobulin clearance and ensure secretory pathway fidelity in antibody-producing cells.
key_evidence: IGLC3: Diagnostic IgLambda light chain constant region; 100% plasma cell specificity indicates lambda-restricted programme
SSR4: Translocon-associated protein complex delta subunit; essential for co-translational translocation of nascent Ig chains
FKBP11: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerase catalysing proline-rich Ig domain folding; critical for immunoglobulin maturation
SEC11C: Signal peptidase C; processes N-terminal signal peptides of secretory Ig molecules during translocation
SDF2L1: ER chaperone cofactor with misfolded protein binding; coordinates refolding of misfolded Ig intermediates
ERLEC1: ER lectin recognising N-glycans on misfolded glycoproteins; initiates ERAD triage decisions
DERL3: Derlin family ERAD component; extracts terminally misfolded Ig from ER for proteasomal degradation
XBP1: IRE1α-activated UPR transcription factor; drives ER chaperone and ERAD gene expression in response to Ig load
suggested_validation: Compare XBP1s (spliced, active) vs XBP1u (unspliced, inactive) ratio by qRT-PCR in IGLC3+ vs IGKC+ plasma cells; validate ER stress status by monitoring ATF4 phosphorylation and CHOP expression as downstream UPR effectors; confirm ERAD flux using pulse-chase labelling with proteasome inhibitors (MG132) to assess DERL3-dependent Ig turnover kinetics.

programme_name: ER chaperone-mediated Ig folding and ERAD
functional_description: This programme coordinates endoplasmic reticulum protein quality control during immunoglobulin secretion, with simultaneous activation of molecular chaperones (HSP90B1, FKBP2, FKBP11, SDF2L1, MANF) for Ig heavy/light chain folding and ER-associated protein degradation (DERL3, HERPUD1) for misfolded protein clearance. The presence of JCHAIN and IGLL5 indicates active light chain production alongside chaperone-dependent folding, while signal peptide processing (SEC11C) and translocon machinery (SSR4) coordinate co-translational translocation into the ER lumen.
key_evidence: HSP90B1: ATP-dependent ER chaperone essential for Ig heavy chain folding in plasma cells
FKBP2, FKBP11: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerases catalysing proline-dependent folding of Ig constant regions
SDF2L1: ER-resident chaperone cofactor binding misfolded proteins and promoting refolding
DERL3: ER-resident derlin family member mediating ERAD substrate retrotranslocation
HERPUD1: ER stress response protein upregulated during UPR signalling and ERAD initiation
SEC11C: Signal peptidase cleaving signal peptides from nascent Ig chains during translocation
SSR4: Translocon-associated protein complex subunit enabling co-translational translocation
JCHAIN: J-chain mediating polymerisation of IgA/IgM; diagnostic of secretory Ig synthesis
IGLL5: Lambda-like immunoglobulin chain; indicates concurrent light chain production
MANF: ER-localised chaperone and secreted neurotrophic factor supporting ER homeostasis
suggested_validation: Perform XBP1s ChIP-seq or ATAC-seq on sorted plasma cells to confirm these genes are direct targets of the unfolded protein response transcription factor, combined with functional validation showing that DERL3 or HERPUD1 knockdown impairs Ig secretion and accumulates misfolded Ig in the ER (by immunofluorescence and immunoprecipitation).

programme_name: XBP1-driven ER chaperone and ERAD pathway
functional_description: This programme represents the unfolded protein response (UPR) initiated by XBP1 activation in antibody-secreting plasma cells, characterized by coordinated induction of ER translocon machinery (SSR4, SEC11C), peptidyl-prolyl isomerases (FKBP11) for immunoglobulin folding, ERAD components (HERPUD1, ERLEC1), and ER oxidoreductases (PRDX4) to manage the proteotoxic burden of massive immunoglobulin secretion. The co-expression of IGKC (kappa light chain) indicates this is specifically active in kappa-secreting plasma cells managing IgK folding and quality control.
key_evidence: XBP1: Master transcription factor of the UPR that directly activates ER chaperones and ERAD genes in secretory-competent plasma cells
HERPUD1: ER stress-responsive ERAD ubiquitin ligase that targets misfolded proteins for proteasomal degradation—diagnostic of active UPR signalling
FKBP11: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerase essential for proline-rich immunoglobulin domain folding; upregulation indicates high-capacity folding demand
SSR4: Translocon-associated protein required for co-translational translocation of nascent heavy and light chains into the ER lumen
ERLEC1: ER-resident lectin that recognizes misfolded N-glycosylated proteins for ERAD—specifically activated during Ig overload stress
PRDX4: ER-localized peroxiredoxin that detoxifies ROS generated by disulfide bond formation during Ig folding
suggested_validation: Perform XBP1 chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP-seq) on sorted bone marrow plasma cells to confirm XBP1 directly binds the promoters of HERPUD1, ERLEC1, FKBP11, and SSR4; validate with ATAC-seq to confirm ER stress-responsive chromatin accessibility at these loci, and confirm kappa-specificity by co-staining flow cytometry of XBP1s+ cells for surface kappa vs lambda expression.

programme_name: IgLambda light chain secretory pathway maturation
functional_description: This programme represents the final maturation phase of plasma cells specializing in IgLambda light chain secretion, characterized by coordinated activation of signal peptide processing machinery (SEC11C, SSR4), ER-resident protein folding catalysts (FKBP11, FKBP2, PDIA6, P4HB), and oxidative protein quality control (PRDX4). The presence of XBP1 and MZB1 indicates active XBP1-mediated UPR transcriptional response coupled with plasma cell survival signalling, while IGLC2 specifically marks lambda light chain production.
key_evidence: IGLC2: Diagnostic lambda light chain constant region; distinguishes IgLambda from IgKappa isotype
SEC11C: Signal peptidase catalyzing N-terminal signal peptide removal from nascent Ig light chains during translocon translocation
SSR4: Core translocon-associated protein required for co-translational translocation of immunoglobulin into ER lumen
XBP1: Master regulator of plasma cell UPR; activates ER expansion and chaperone genes including PDIA6, P4HB, FKBP family
FKBP11/FKBP2/PDIA6/P4HB: Coordinated ER chaperone and isomerase panel catalyzing proline-rich Ig domain folding and disulfide bond formation
PRDX4: ER-localized peroxiredoxin providing antioxidant defence during high-volume immunoglobulin synthesis
MZB1: Plasma cell-specific survival factor and regulator of cell proliferation in secretory state
suggested_validation: Perform cell surface isotype staining (anti-IgLambda/IgKappa) combined with XBP1-GFP reporter or XBP1s splicing RT-qPCR to confirm IgLambda+ plasma cells show elevated XBP1 splicing and coordinate upregulation of SEC11C, PDIA6, P4HB by single-cell RT-qPCR or RNA fluorescence in situ hybridization.

programme_name: IgLambda light chain secretion with ER-resident chaperone folding
functional_description: This programme represents IgLambda-expressing plasma cells engaged in active immunoglobulin secretion with coordinated ER proteostasis. The feature integrates IGLC2 (lambda light chain constant region) with a distinctive ER chaperone and quality control signature: FKBP11 and FKBP2 (prolyl isomerases essential for disulphide bond isomerisation in Ig folding), HSP90B1 (ER-resident chaperone), MANF (ER-Golgi shuttling cytoprotective chaperone), and ERLEC1 (N-glycan-dependent ERAD component), indicating coupled synthesis, folding, and selective degradation of misfolded Ig in the secretory pathway.
key_evidence: IGLC2: diagnostic marker of lambda light chain constant region—defines IgLambda-expressing plasma cell subset
FKBP11 & FKBP2: peptidyl-prolyl cis/trans isomerases critical for correct disulphide isomerisation in multi-chain Ig molecules
HSP90B1: ATP-dependent ER chaperone required for heavy-chain and multi-chain Ig complex folding and stability
ERLEC1: ER-resident lectin detecting misfolded N-glycosylated proteins—gates ERAD of defective Ig
MANF: ER-Golgi resident cytoprotective chaperone promoting secretory pathway robustness under proteotoxic stress

functional_description: This programme coordinates the unfolded protein response (UPR) initiated by XBP1 splicing to support massive immunoglobulin production in plasma cells. HLA-DMB: peptide exchange factor for class II MHC - catalyzes removal of invariant chain-derived peptides
CD79A: B-cell receptor complex signalling component for antigen recognition
BANK1: BCR-coupled scaffolding protein for downstream calcium signaling and B-cell activation
MS4A1/CD20: B-cell pan-marker and co-stimulatory molecule in antigen presentation
